उ: 1. उ the fifth letter and third short vowel of the alphabet, pronounced as the u in full.
2. उ ind. an interjection of compassion, anger, L.
a particle implying assent, calling, command, L.
3. उ ind. an enclitic copula used frequently in the Vedas;

(as a particle implying restriction and antithesis, generally after pronominals, prepositions, particles, and before नु and सु, equivalent to) and, also, further; on the other hand (especially in connexion with a relative e.g. य उ, he on the contrary who &c.)

This particle may serve to give emphasis, like इद् and एव, especially after prepositions or demonstrative pronouns, in conjunction with नु, वै, हि, चिद्, &c. (e.g. अय॑म् उ वाम् पुरुत॑मो... जोहवीति [RV. iii, 62, 2], this very person [your worshipper] invokes you &c.) It is especially used in the figure of speech called Anaphora, and particularly when the pronouns are repeated (e.g. त॑म् उ स्तुष इ॑न्द्रम् त॑म् गृणीषे [RV. ii, 20, 4], him I praise, Indra, him I sing). It may be used in drawing a conclusion, like the English ‘now’ (e.g. त॑द् उ त॑था न॑ कुर्यात् [ŚBr. v, 2, 2, 3], that now he should not do in such a manner), and is frequently found in interrogative sentences (e.g. क॑ उ त॑च् चिकेत [RV. i, 164, 48], who, I ask, should know that?)
Pāṇini calls this particle उञ् to distinguish it from the interrogative उ. In the Pada-pāṭha it is written ऊम्.
In the classical language उ occurs only after अथ, न, and किम्, with a slight modification of the sense, and often only as an expletive (See किम्);
उ — उ or उ — उत, on the one hand - on the other hand; partly — partly; as well — as.

उच्छिष्टभाज्: उ॑च्-छिष्ट—भाज् mfn. receiving the remainder, Gobh. iv, 3, 28.
उच्छिष्टभोक्तृ: उ॑च्-छिष्ट—भोक्तृ mfn. one who eats leavings, Mn. iv, 212
उच्छिष्टभोजन: उ॑च्-छिष्ट—भोजन n. eating the leavings of another man, Mn.
उ॑च्-छिष्ट—भोजन m. one who eats another's leavings
the attendant upon an idol (whose food is the leavings of offerings), L.
उच्छिष्टभोजिन्: उ॑च्-छिष्ट—भोजिन्, mfn. or उ॑च्-छिष्ट—मोदन, n. wax, L.
उच्छिष्टमोदन: उ॑च्-छिष्ट—भोजिन्, mfn. or उ॑च्-छिष्ट—मोदन, n. wax, L.
उच्छिष्टाशन: उच्छिष्टाशन n. eating leavings, Gaut. ii, 32.
उच्छिष्टित: उच्-छिष्टित mfn. made impure, defiled, Parāś.
उच्छिष्य: उच्-छिष्य mfn. to be left, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 123.
उच्छेषण: उच्-छे॑षण n. remainder, leavings, TS.; Mn.
उच्छेषणीकृ: उच्छेषणी-√ कृ to leave as a remainder, Daś.
उच्छी: उच्-छी (उद्-√ शी) Ā. (3. du. -छ्याते, ŚBr. iv, 5, 7, 5) to be prominent, stand out, stick out.
उच्छीर्षक: उच्-छीर्षक mfn. (उद्-शी°) one who has raised his head, Suśr.
उच्-छीर्षक n. ‘that which raises the head’, a pillow.
उच्छुच्: उच्-छुच् (उद्-√ शुच्), Caus. P. (p. -छोच॑यत्) to inflame, AV. v, 22, 2.
उच्छोचन: उच्-छो॑चन a mfn. burning, AV. vii, 95, 1.
उच्छुन: उच्-छुन m. N. of Vaiśākha, L.
उच्छुष्: उच्-छुष् (उद्-√ शुष्) P. -छुष्यति, to dry up, ChUp. iv, 3, 2 : Caus. -छोषयति, to cause to dry up; to parch, MBh.; R.; Śārṅg.
उच्छुष्क: उच्-छुष्क mfn. dry, dried up, withered, Mṛcch.; Kathās.; Rājat.
उच्छोषण: उच्-छोषण a mfn. making dry, parching, Bhag.
उच्छोषुक: उच्-छो॑षुक mfn. drying up, withering, ŚBr.; GopBr.
उच्छुष्म: उच्-छुष्म mfn. (उद्-शुष्म [√ 2. शुष्]) one whose crackling becomes manifest (said of Agni), TS.; AVPar.
उच्छुष्मा: उच्-छुष्मा f. N. of a plant, Kauś.
उच्छुष्मकल्प: उच्-छुष्म—कल्प m. N. of a section of the Atharva-veda-pariśiṣṭa.
उच्छुष्मरुद्र: उच्-छुष्म—रुद्र m. pl. N. of a class of demons, AVPar.
उच्छून: उच्-छून b mfn. swollen up, swollen, bloated, Megh.; Kathās. &c.
उच्छृङ्खल: irregular, desultory, unmethodical, Pañcat.; Hit.; Kathās. &c.
उच्छृङ्गित: उच्-छृङ्गित (उद्-शृ°) mfn. (fr. शृङ्ग), having erected horns, Śiś. v, 63.
उच्छ्रथ्: उच्-छ्रथ् (उद्-√ श्रथ्), Caus. P. (Impv. 2. sg. -श्रथाय, RV. i, 24, 15) to untie.
उच्छ्रि: उच्-छ्रि (उद्-√ श्रि) P. -छ्रयति (aor. उ॑द्-अश्रेत्, RV. vii, 62, 1 and 76, 1) to raise, erect, extol, RV.; VS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; Lāṭy.; MBh.; R. &c.: Ā. -छ्रयते (Impv. 2. sg. -छ्रयस्व, RV. iii, 8, 3) to rise, stand erect, RV.; VS.; AitBr. &c.: Pass. -छ्रीयते (pf. -छिश्रिये) to be erected, AitBr.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Prab. : Caus. -छ्रापयति, to raise, erect, VS. xxiii, 26.
उच्छ्रय: the upright side of a triangle.
उच्छ्रयोपेत: उच्छ्रयोपेत mfn. possessing height, high, lofty, elevated.
उच्छ्रयण: उच्-छ्रयण n. raising erecting, KātyŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.; VarBṛS.
उच्छ्राय: उच्-छ्राय m. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 49) rising upwards, elevation, height, MBh.; Yājñ.; Suśr.; Pañcat.
उच्छ्रायी: उच्-छ्रायी॑ f. an upraised piece of wood, plank, KātyŚr.; ŚBr.
उच्छ्रायिन्: उच्छ्रायिन् mfn. high, raised, lofty, W.
उच्छ्रित: उच्-छ्रित mfn. raised, lifted up, erected, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; R.; Ragh.; Kathās. &c.
rising, arising, mounting, MBh.; Hariv.; MārkP.; VarBṛS. &c.
high, tall, R.; BhP.; Kir.; Suśr.; VarBṛS. &c.
advancing, arisen, grown powerful or mighty, MBh.; Kathās.; Mn.; Hit. &c.
increased, grown, enlarged, large, huge, Prab.; Ragh.
उच्छ्रिति: उच्-छ्रिति f. rising upwards, elevation, MārkP.
the upright side of a triangle
the elevation or height of a figure.
उच्छ्रित्य: उच्-छ्रित्य ind.p. having erected or raised, MBh.
उच्छ्लख: उच्-छ्लख॑ (उद्-श्ल्°), औ m. du. a particular part of the human body, AV. x, 2, 1.
उच्छ्वञ्च्: उच्-छ्वञ्च् (उद्-√ श्वञ्च्) Ā. (Impv. 2. sg. उ॑च्-छ्वञ्चस्व, RV. x, 18, 11 and 142, 6) to gape, cleave open.
उच्छ्वङ्क: उच्-छ्वङ्क॑ m. gaping, cleaving open, forming a fissure, ŚBr. v, 4, 1, 9.
उच्छ्वस्: उच्-छ्वस् (उद्-√ श्वस्) P. Ā. -छ्वसिति (p. -छ्वसत्, -छ्वसमान; Pot. -छ्वसेत्, -छ्वसीत) to breathe hard, snort; to take a deep breath, breathe; to breathe again, get breath, recover, rest, Gobh.; MBh.; BhP.; Suśr.; MārkP.; ŚvetUp. &c.; to sigh, pant, respire, Bhaṭṭ.; to rise, Vikr.; to unfasten one's self, BhP.; to open, begin to bloom, Vikr.; Mālav.; to heave: Caus. -छ्वासयति, to cause to breathe again or recover; to gladden, BhP.; to raise, lift, elevate; to untie (cf. उच्-छ्वासित below).
उच्छ्वसत्: उच्-छ्वसत् m. (अन्) a breathing being, R.
उच्छ्वसित: उच्-छ्वसित mfn. heaving, beating, breathed, inspired
revived, refreshed, gladdened, Kum.; Mālav.; Kathās.; Ragh. &c.
heaving, swelling up, raised, lifted, Ragh.; Kathās.; Megh. &c.
throbbing, sighing, Sāh.; Ragh.; Kum.; Śak.
उच्छ्वास: breath, deep inspiration, KātyŚr.; Suśr.; Śak.; Prab. &c.
pause in a narration, division of a book (e.g. of the Daśakumāra-carita)
उच्छ्वासित: उच्-छ्वासित mfn. caused to recover, gladdened, Ṛtus.; Kathās.
उच्छ्वासिन्: उच्-छ्वासिन् mfn. breathing out, expiring, ŚBr.
swelling up, rising, coming forward, Vikr.; Kum. &c.
उच्छ्: 1. उछ् cl. 1. P. उच्छति, RV. See √ 3. वस्.
2. उछ् cl. 1. P. उच्छति, उच्छां-चकार, उच्छितुम्, &c., to finish; to bind; to abandon, transgress, Dhātup.
उछ्: 1. उछ् cl. 1. P. उच्छति, RV. See √ 3. वस्.
2. उछ् cl. 1. P. उच्छति, उच्छां-चकार, उच्छितुम्, &c., to finish; to bind; to abandon, transgress, Dhātup.
उज्जन्: उज्-√ जन् (उद्-√ जन्), only, RV. : P. (pf. -जजा॑न, iii, 1, 12) to beget, produce : Ā. (impf. 3. pl. उद्-अ॑जायन्त, iv, 18, 1; aor. -अ॑जनि, i, 74, 3; precative of the aor. -जनिषीष्ट, vii, 8, 6) to be born or produced, originate.
उज्जयन: उज्-जयन b m. N. of a man, MBh.
उज्जस्: उज्-√ जस् (उद्-√ जस्), Caus. P. -जासयति, to destroy, extirpate, kill (with gen. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56), Bhaṭṭ.; Śiś.
उज्जागृ: उज्-√ जागृ (उद्-√ जागृ) P. (pf. -जगार, [?] Hcar. 140, 3) to pass (time) waking: Caus. -जागरयति, to awake, call up, Sāh.; to excite; to effect, cause, Kāvyâd.
उज्जानक: उज्-जानक m. N. of a Tīrtha, MBh.; Hariv.
उज्जालुक: उज्जालुक m. N. of a place, MBh.
उज्जि: उज्-√ जि (उद्-√ जि) P. -जयति (pf. -जिगाय, &c.) to win, conquer, acquire by conquest, AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; TBr. &c.; to be victorious, AV.; TBr. : Caus. -जापयति, to assist any one to win; to cause to conquer (with two acc.), Kāṭh.; TāṇḍyaBr. &c.: Desid. -जिगीषति, to wish to conquer, ŚāṅkhŚr.
उज्जयनी: उज्-जयनी f. Ujjayinī (See below) or Oujein.
उज्जयन्त: उज्-जयन्त m. N. of a mountain in Surāṣṭra (in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range), MBh.
उज्जयिनी: उज्-जयिनी f. the city Oujein (the Gk. ᾿Οζήνη, a city so called in Avanti or Mālava, formerly the capital of Vikramāditya; it is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindūs, and the first meridian of their geographers, from which they calculate longitude; the modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city), Hit.; Megh.; Rājat. &c.
उज्जिति: उ॑ज्-जिति f. victory, VS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.
N. of the verses, VS. ix, 31 sqq. (so called because the words उ॑दजयत् तम् उ॑ज्जेषम् occur in them), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उज्जेष: उज्-जेष॑ mf(आ)n. victorious, AV. iv, 17, 1 (voc. fem. उ॑ज्-जेषे), ŚBr.
उज्जेषवत्: उज्-जेष॑—वत् (उज्-जेष॑-) mfn. containing the word उज्जेष, ŚBr.
उज्जेषिन्: उज्जेषि॑न् m. N. of one of the seven Maruts, VS. xvii, 85.
उज्जिगमिषा: उज्-जिगमिषा f. (fr. Desid. of √ गम्) desire of coming forth, Kāvyâd.
उज्जिहान: उज्-जि॑हान b mfn. (pres. p. See above)
उज्-जि॑हान m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS. 14, 2
उज्जिहीर्षा: उज्-जिहीर्षा f. (fr. Desid. of √ हृ with उद्), wishing to take or seize [see also 2. उद्धृ].
उज्जिहीर्षु: उज्-जिहीर्षु (fr. Desid. of उद् + √ हृ), wishing to extricate or rescue, MBh.
उज्जीव्: उज्-√ जीव् (उद्-√ जीव्) P. -जीवति, to revive, return to life, Bhaṭṭ.; MBh. : Caus. P. -जीवयति, to restore to life, animate Comm. on Kum.
उज्जीविन्: उज्-जीविन् m. N. of a counsellor of Meghavarṇa (king of the crows), Pañcat.
उज्जूटडिम्ब: उज्जूट-डिम्ब n. N. of a place, Rājat. (v.l. उज्झट°).
उज्जूटित: उज्-जूटित mfn. one who wears the hair twisted together and coiled upwards, Rājat.
उज्जृम्भ्: उज्-√ जृम्भ् (उद्-√ जृम्भ्) Ā. -जृम्भते, to gape; to open, part asunder, BhP.; to show one's self, become visible, come forth, break forth, expand, arise, Prab.; Naiṣ.; Dhūrtas.
उज्जृम्भण: उज्-जृम्भण n. the act of gaping, opening the mouth, Suśr.
उज्जृम्भणा: उज्-जृम्भणा f. coming forth, arising, Bālar.
उज्जेन्द्र: उज्जेन्द्र m. N. of a man, Rājat.
उज्ज्य: उज्-ज्य mfn. (fr. ज्या with उद्), having the bow-sinew loosened, BṛĀrUp.; KātyŚr.
उज्ज्वल्: उज्-√ ज्वल् (उद्-√ ज्वल्) P. -ज्वलति, -ज्वलिति (Pāṇ. vii, 2, 34), to blaze up, flame, shine, TS.; ŚBr.; R.; BhP. : Caus. P. : -ज्वलयति, to light up, cause to shine, illuminate, ŚBr.; Rājat.; Śiś. &c.
उज्ज्वल: उज्-ज्वल mfn. blazing up, luminous, splendid, light
lovely, beautiful, Suśr.; MBh.; Kathās.; Sāh. &c.
उज्ज्वला: a form of the Jagatī metre.
उज्ज्वलता: उज्-ज्वल—ता, f. or उज्-ज्वल—त्व, n. splendour, radiance
उज्ज्वलत्व: उज्-ज्वल—ता, f. or उज्-ज्वल—त्व, n. splendour, radiance
उज्ज्वलदत्त: उज्-ज्वल—दत्त m. N. of the author of a commentary on the Uṇādi-sūtras.
उज्ज्वलनरसिंह: उज्-ज्वल—नर-सिंह m. N. of a Tīrtha.
उज्ज्वलितत्व: उज्-ज्वलित—त्व n. the state of being lighted, Kap.
उज्झ्: उज्झ् cl. 6. P. उज्झति, उज्झां चकार, औज्झीत्, उज्झितुम्, &c. (probably a contraction from उद्- √ 2. हा [-जहाति]) to leave, abandon, quit, Ragh.; Pañcat.; MBh. &c.; to avoid, escape, Ragh.; Śiś.; to emit, discharge, let out.
उज्झन: उज्झन n. removing Comm. on Yājñ.
उज्झितकर्णक: उज्झित-कर्णक mfn. destitute of ear-rings, Bcar.
उज्झितवत्: उज्झित—वत् mfn. one who has emitted or discharged, Śiś. v, 36.

उज्झटडिम्ब: उज्झट-डिम्ब and उज्झटित vv.ll. for उज्जूट-डिम्ब and उज्जूटित, qq.v.

उञ्चदेश: उञ्च-देश m. N. of a country.
उञ्छ्: उञ्छ् cl. 1. 6.P. उञ्छति, to gather, glean, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
उञ्छ: उञ्छ m. gleaning, gathering grains, Mn.; MBh.; R.
उञ्छवर्तिन्: उञ्छ—वर्तिन् or उञ्छ—वृत्ति, mfn. one who lives by gleaning, a gleaner, MBh.
उञ्छवृत्ति: उञ्छ—वर्तिन् or उञ्छ—वृत्ति, mfn. one who lives by gleaning, a gleaner, MBh.
उञ्छशिल: उञ्छ—शिल n. the gleaning, gathering, Mn. iv, 5; L. (cf. शिलोञ्छ.)
उञ्छादि: उञ्छादि m. N. of a g. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 160).
उञ्छन: उञ्छन n. gleaning, gathering grains of corn in market-places &c., BhP. &c.
उट: उट m. leaves, grass &c. (used in making huts, thatches &c.), L.
उटज: उट—ज mn. a hut made of leaves (the residence of hermits or saints), MBh.; R.; Ragh.; Śak. &c.
उट्टङ्कन: उट्-टङ्कन (उद्-ट°) n. the act of stamping, characterizing, Sāh.
उट्टङ्कित: उट्टङ्कित mfn. marked by, showing traces of (comp.), Vcar.
उठ्: उठ् or ऊठ् cl. 1. P. ओठति or ऊठति, to strike or knock down, Dhātup. ix, 54.
उडु: उडु fn. a star, Ragh.; BhP.; Mālav. &c.
उडु n. a lunar mansion or constellation in the moon's path, VarBṛS. &c.
उडुगणाधिप: उडु—गणाधिप m. ‘the lord of the stars’, the moon

a kind of drinking vessel covered with leather Comm. on Ragh. i, 2
the moon (the half-moon being formed like a boat), MBh.; Mṛcch. &c.
उडुपभृत्: उड्-उप—भृत् m. N. of Śiva, Kāv.

उडुराज्: उडु—पति or उडु—राज्, m. the moon, MBh.; R.; Kum. &c.
उडुपथ: उडु—पथ m. ‘the path of the stars’, the ether, firmament.

the threshold of a house, VarBṛS.

the fruit of the tree Ficus Glomerata, ŚBr.
a karsha (a measure of two tolas), ŚārṅgS.

2. उत॑ ind. and, also, even, or, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.

often used for the sake of emphasis, especially at the end of a line after इति or a verb (e.g. सर्व-भूतानि तम् पार्थ सदा परिभवन्त्य् उत, all creatures, O king, certainly always despise him, MBh. iii, 1026), MBh.; Bhag. &c. (As an interrogative particle, generally at the beginning of the second or following part of a double interrogation) or, utrum - an (e.g. कथम् निर्णीयते किं स्यान् निष्कारणो बन्धुर् उत विश्वास-घातकः, how can it be decided whether he be a friend without a motive or a violator of confidence? Hit.), Kum.; Kathās.; Bhartṛ.; Sāh. &c.

in this sense it may be strengthened by आहो (e.g. कच्चित् त्वम् असि मानुषी उताहो सुराङ्गना, art thou a mortal woman or divine? Nala), or by आहो-स्वित् (e.g. शालिहोत्रः किं नु स्याद् उताहोस्विद् राजा नलः, can it be Śālihotra or king Nala?) Rarely किम् is repeated before उत used in this sense (e.g. किम् नु स्वर्गात् प्राप्ता तस्या रूपेण किमुतान्यागता, has she arrived from heaven or has another come in her form? Mṛcch.), Amar.; MBh. &c. (As a particle of wishing, especially at the beginning of a sentence followed by a potential) would that! utinam! (e.g. उताधीयीत, would that he would read!) (उत preceded by किम्) on the contrary, how much more, how much less (e.g. समर्थो ऽसि सहस्रम् अपि जेतुं किमुतैकम्, thou art able to conquer even a thousand, how much more one, R.), Śak.; Vikr.; Ragh. &c. (उत preceded by प्रति) on the contrary, rather (e.g. एष पृष्टो ऽस्माभिर् न जल्पति हन्ति प्रत्य्-उत पाषाणैः, this one questioned by us does not speak, but rather throws stones at us), Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.
उत वा, or else, and (e.g. समुद्राद् उत वा पुरीषात्, from the sea or from the moisture in the air)
वा - उत वा or उताहो वापि - वा, either - or
उत - उत, both - and (e.g. उत बलवान् उताबलः, both the strong and the weak)
किम् - उत वा, whether - or else.

उद्: 1. उद् a particle and prefix to verbs and nouns. (As implying superiority in place, rank, station, or power) up, upwards

over, above. (As implying separation and disjunction) out, out of, from, off, away from, apart. (According to native authorities उद् may also imply publicity, pride, indisposition, weakness, helplessness, binding, loosing, existence, acquisition.) उद् is not used as a separable adverb or preposition

in those rare cases, in which it appears in the Veda uncompounded with a verb, the latter has to be supplied from the context (e.g. उ॑द् उ॑त्सम् शत॑धारम्, AV. iii, 24, 4, out (pour) a fountain of a hundred streams). उद् is sometimes repeated in the Veda to fill out the verse, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 6 (किं न उद् उद् उ हर्षसे दातवा उ, Kāś. on Pāṇ.)

उप: उ॑प ind. (a preposition or prefix to verbs and nouns, expressing) towards, near to (opposed to अप, away), by the side of, with, together with, under, down (e.g. उप-√ गम्, to go near, undergo; उप-गमन, approaching; in the Veda the verb has sometimes to be supplied from the context, and sometimes उप is placed after the verb to which it belongs, e.g. आययुर् उप = उपाययुः, they approached). (As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns उप expresses) direction towards, nearness, contiguity in space, time, number, degree, resemblance, and relationship, but with the idea of subordination and inferiority (e.g. उप-कनिष्ठिका, the finger next to the little finger; उप-पुराणम्, a secondary or subordinate Purāṇa; उप-दश, nearly ten)

sometimes forming with the nouns to which it is prefixed compound adverbs (e.g. उप-मूलम्, at the root; उप-पूर्व-रात्रम्, towards the beginning of night; उप-कूपे, near a well) which lose their adverbial terminations if they are again compounded with nouns (e.g. उपकूप-जलाशय, a reservoir in the neighbourhood of a well)

prefixed to proper names उप may express in classical literature ‘a younger brother’ (e.g. उपेन्द्र, ‘the younger brother of Indra’), and in Buddhist literature ‘a son.’ (As a separable adverb उप rarely expresses) thereto, further, moreover (e.g. तत्रोप ब्रह्म यो वेद, who further knows the Brahman), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; PārGṛ. (As a separable preposition) near to, towards, in the direction of, under, below (with acc. e.g. उप आशाः, towards the regions)
at the time of, upon, up to, in, above (with loc. e.g. उप सानुषु, on the tops of the mountains)

with, together with, at the same time with, according to (with inst. e.g. उप धर्मभिः, according to the rules of duty), RV.; AV.; ŚBr. उप, besides the meanings given above, is said by native authorities to imply disease, extinction; ornament; command; reproof; undertaking; giving; killing; diffusing; wish; power; effort; resemblance, &c.;

esoteric doctrine, secret doctrine, mysterious or mystical meaning, words of mystery &c., ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.

a class of philosophical writings (more than a hundred in number, attached to the Brāhmaṇas [but See Īśopaniṣad]; their aim is the exposition of the secret meaning of the Veda, and they are regarded as the source of the Vedānta and Sāṃkhya philosophies; for the most important of the Upaniṣads See IW. p.37seq.)

a main road, road, Gaut. ix, 65; L.

उपनिष्क्रान्त: उप-निष्क्रान्त mfn. one who has gone out of R.

Pot. -नयीत, HirGṛ. i, 1, 2; p. -न॑यमान, AV.) to lead or drive near, bring near, bring, adduce, offer, RV. ii, 3, 10; iii, 35, 3; ŚBr.; TBr.; MBh.; Mn.; Ragh.; to bring information, communicate; to lead or bring near to one's self, take possession of R.; Kathās.; to lead, guide, MBh.; BhP.; to lead or draw towards one's self (said of the Guru who, in the ceremony of initiation, draws the boy towards himself); to initiate into one of the twice-born classes by investing with the sacred thread &c. Pāṇ. i, 3, 36), AV. xi, 5, 3; ŚBr.; ĀśvGṛ.; ŚāṅkhGṛ. &c., Mn. &c.; to bring about, produce, cause, Gīt.; Prab.; Sāh.; to bring into any state, reduce to, R.; Hariv.; Kām. &c.; to take into one's service (only Ā. Pāṇ. i, 3, 36) : Caus. -नाययति, to cause to initiate (a pupil), Mn. xi, 191.

leading or drawing towards one's self

that ceremony in which a Guru draws a boy towards himself and initiates him into one of the three twice-born classes (one of the twelve Saṃskāras or purificatory rites [prescribed in the Dharma-sūtras and explained in the Gṛhya-sūtras] in which the boy is invested with the sacred thread [different for the three castes] and thus endowed with second or spiritual birth and qualified to learn the Veda by heart; a Brāhman is initiated in the eighth year [or seventh according to Hiraṇyakeśin; or eighth from conception, according to Śāṅkhāyana &c.], a Kṣatriya in the eleventh, a Vaiśya in the twelfth; but the term could be delayed)
See IW. p.201 RTL. p.360 seqq.; ĀśvGṛ. i, 19-22; ŚāṅkhGṛ. ii, 1-6; PārGṛ. ii, 2-5; Gobh. ii, 10; HirGṛ. i, 1 seqq.; Mn. ii, 36; Yājñ. i, 14.

उपनायिन्: उप-नायिन् mfn. bringing near, fetching, MBh.

led to a man, married (?), RV. x, 109, 4 = AV. v, 17, 6

उपनीति: उप-नीति f. initiation = उप-नयन above, Nyāyam.
उपनेतव्य: उप-नेतव्य mfn. to be brought near
उपनेतृ: उप-नेतृ mf(त्री)n. one who brings near, Kum. i, 61
उप-नेतृ m. (ता) the spiritual preceptor, Pañcat.
उपनेय: उप-नेय mfn. to be adduced as an example, Jātakam.
उपनुन्न: उप-नुन्न mfn. driven near, wafted, Śiś. iv, 68.
उपनृत्: उप-√ नृत् P. Ā. -नृत्यति, -ते, to dance before, dance round (acc.), MBh.; Hariv.; R.
उपनृत्त: उप-नृत्त mfn. any person before or round whom it is danced, MBh. v, 4100.
उपनृत्य: उप-नृत्य n. a place for dancing, R.
उपन्यस्: उप-न्य्-√ 2. अस् P. -अस्यति, to place down, put down, R.; to announce, MBh.; to speak of, mention; to explain; to hint, allude, suggest, Kir.; Kāvyapr.
उपन्यस्त: उप-न्यस्त mfn. mentioned, explained, brought forward, hinted at, alluded, Yājñ.; Śak. 200, 2; Hit.

quotation, reference, Mn.; Mālav.; Sāh.; Daśar. &c.
a particular kind of treaty or alliance, Kām.; Hit.
उपन्यास्य: उप-न्यास्य mfn. to be adduced or stated, W.

उपपत्: उप-√ पत् P. -पतति, to fly near, hasten towards, RV.; BhP.

उपपातिन्: उप-पातिन् mfn. ifc. falling to, hastening towards.

उपपथम्: उप-पथम् ind. on the way or road, Vop.

P. -पादयति, to bring to any state (with two acc.); to cause anything (acc.) to arrive at (loc. or dat.), cause to come into the possession of, offer, present, MBh.; MārkP.; Mn.; Yājñ.; Ragh. &c.; to cause to come forth or exist; to accomplish, effect, cause, produce, Lāṭy.; MBh.; Megh. &c.; to get ready, prepare, make fit or adequate for, make conformable to, MBh.; R.; to furnish or provide or endow with, MBh.; Kām. &c.; to make anything out of Prab.; to examine; to find out, ascertain, R.; Mn. &c.; to prove, justify, Sarvad. ascertained or demonstrated conclusion, proof, evidence, argument, Sarvad.; Sāh.; Vedāntas.; Naiṣ.; Rājat. &c.

one who has approached for protection, R.
one who has obtained or reached, MBh.; R.; Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 13
happened, fallen to one's share, produced, effected, existing, being near at hand, MBh.; Yājñ.; Ragh. &c.
endowed with, possessed of, furnished with, MBh.; Mn. &c.
fit, suited for the occasion, adequate, conformable, Śak.; Vikr.; Rājat. &c.
उपपन्नार्थ: उप-पन्नार्थ mfn. having good reasons, MBh.
उपपादक: उप-पादक mfn. causing to occur or happen, producing, effecting, making visible, Sāh.

proving or establishing by argument, Sarvad.

(वृक्षाः कल्पो-पपदाः, ‘those trees which have the word कल्प as accompanying word’ = कल्प-वृक्षाः, Śiś. iii 59; cf. Ragh. xvi, 40)

उपप्राण: उप-प्राण m. a secondary vital air belonging to the body, W.
उपप्राप्त: उप-प्राप्त mfn. approached, come near, R.
उपप्राया: उप-प्रा-√ या P. (Impv. 2. du. -यातम्) to come near, RV. vii, 70, 6.
उपप्रुत्: उप-प्रु॑त् mfn. (fr. √ प्रु = √ प्लु, BRD.) flowing or rushing near, RV. ix, 71, 2
उपप्रे: उप-प्रे (उप-प्र-√ इ) P. -एति, to go or come near to, approach, rush upon; to set about, undertake, begin, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; KenUp. : Ā. -प्लायते (for -प्रायते) to rush upon, MaitrS. i, 10, 14; 16.
उपप्रेक्ष्: उप-प्रेक्ष् (उप-प्र-√ ईक्ष्) P. (2. sg. प्रेक्षसि) to overlook, pass over unnoticed, disregard, MBh.
उपप्रेक्षण: उप-प्रेक्षण n. the act of overlooking, looking at without interest, disregarding, MBh.
उपप्रेष्: उप-प्रेष् (उप-प्र- 1 √ इष्) P. -प्रेष्यति (Impv. 2. du. -प्रेष्यतम्) to impel, AV. xviii, 2, 53; to invite, summon (said of the Adhvaryu priest who summons the Hotṛ priest to sacrifice), AitBr. ii, 5, 6; 8.
उपप्रैष: उप-प्रैष m. invitation, summons (See the preceding), AitBr. ii, 5, 7; 8.
उपप्लु: उप-√ प्लु P. -प्लवति, to overflow, inundate; to assault, invade, afflict; to eclipse, Kauś.; to rush upon, assail, MBh. : Ā. -प्लवते, to swim on the surface (as a light object) Comm. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 126; to hang over, move aloft, TāṇḍyaBr.; Kāṭh. : Caus. -प्लावयति, to irrigate, flood, water, BhP.; to float near (?), ŚBr. xiii, 1, 2, 9.
उपप्लव: उप-प्लव m. affliction, visitation, invasion, inundation
any public calamity, unlucky accident, misfortune, disturbance
a portent or natural phenomenon (as an eclipse &c.), MBh.; Suśr.; Vikr.; Kum.; Kathās. &c.
N. of Rāhu (who is supposed to cause eclipses), L.
उपप्लविन्: उपप्लविन् mfn. afflicted or visited by a calamity, Ragh.
उपप्लव्य: उप-प्लव्य n. N. of the capital of the Matsyas.; MBh.
उपप्लुत: swallowed (as sun and moon by Rāhu), eclipsed, R.; BhP.; Mn.; Ragh. &c.
उपप्लुता: उप-प्लुता f. (with योनि) a particular disease of the female organ, ŚārṅgS.; Car.
उपप्लुतेक्षण: उपप्लुतेक्षण mfn. having overflowing eyes, weeping, Hariv.
उपबन्ध्: उप-√ बन्ध् P. (3. pl. -बध्नन्ति) to tie up, fasten, ŚBr. ii, 1, 4, 3 Comm. on Bādar.
उपबद्ध: उ॑प-बद्ध mfn. tied up, fastened, AV. i, 7, 7; ŚBr. xi, 5, 1, 2
उपबन्ध: application, employment, use (of a word &c.), Bādar.
a particular manner of sitting, Caurap.
उपबहु: उप-बहु mfn. tolerably numerous, a good many, Kāś. on Pāṇ. v, 4, 73.
उपबाहु: उप-बाहु m. the lower arm (from the elbow to the wrist), VarBṛS.
N. of a man g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96.
उपबिन्दु: उप-बिन्दु m. N. of a man g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96.
उपबिल: उप-बिल mfn. near the aperture Comm. on KātyŚr.
उपबिलम्: उप-बिलम् ind. to the brim, ĀpŚr.
उपबृह्: उप-√ बृह् Intens. P. (Subj. -ब॑र्बृहत्; Impv. 2. sg. -बर्बृहि) to press with the arms or cling closely (to a man dat.); to embrace closely or passionately, RV. v, 61, 5; x, 10, 10; Nir. (cf. उप-√ वृंह्.)
उपबर्हण: उप-ब॑र्हण n. a cushion, pillow, RV. x, 85, 7; AV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; TBr. &c.
उप-ब॑र्हण m. N. of the Gandharva Narada, BhP.; VP.; Pañcar. &c. (उपबर्हण)
उप-बर्हण mf(आ)n. having a cushion, furnished with a pillow, Vait. 36, 7.
उपबर्हिण: उप-बर्हिण m. N. of a mountain, BhP. v, 20, 21.
उपबृंहण: उप-बृंहण See उप-वृंहण, °वृंहिन् under उप-√ वृंह्.
उपबृंहिन्: उप-बृंहिन् See उप-वृंहण, °वृंहिन् under उप-√ वृंह्.
उपब्द: उपब्द॑ m. noise, sound, rattling, clanking, RV. vii, 104, 17 (= AV. viii, 4, 17).
उपब्दि: (voc. उ॑पब्दे) a particular venomous animal ([NBD.]), AV. ii, 24, 6.
उपब्दिमत्: उपब्दि॑—म॑त् mfn. noisy, loud, TS.; AitBr.
उपब्रू: उप-√ ब्रू Ā. -ब्रूते (once P. impf. 1. sg. -अब्रवम्, RV. viii, 24, 14) to speak to, address; to invoke for, entreat, ask for; to persuade, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh.
उपब्लय: उप-ब्लय m. the region round the clavicle, Lāṭy. i, 5, 7.
उपभक्षित: उप-भक्षित mfn. eaten up, consumed, Suśr.
उपभङ्ग: उप-भङ्ग m. (√ भञ्ज्), a division of a stanza, Vikr.
उपभज्: उप-√ भज् Ā. (aor. -अ॑भक्त) to obtain, take possession of (acc.), RV. ix, 102, 2.
उपभाषा: उप-भाषा f. a secondary dialect, Dhūrtas.
उपभुज्: उप-√ 2. भुज् Ā. -भुङ्क्ते, (ep. also -भुञ्जते) to enjoy, eat, eat up, consume, MBh.; Yājñ.; Pañcat. &c.; to enjoy, make use of, partake of; to experience (happiness or misfortune &c.), MBh.; Hariv.; Mn.; BhP. &c.; to enjoy (a woman), Hariv.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.; to receive as a reward, Mn. xii, 8; R. vi, 98, 29 : P. (1. pl. -भुञ्जामस्) to be useful, ChUp. iv, 11, 2 : Caus. -भोजयति, to cause to take (medicine), Suśr.
उपभुक्तधन: उप-भुक्त—धन mfn. one who has enjoyed or made use of his riches
उप-भुक्त—धन m. N. of a merchant's son, Pañcat. (also in the former meaning).
उपभुक्ति: (in astron.) the daily course of a star (= भुक्ति q.v.)
उपभोक्तृ: उप-भोक्तृ mfn. one who enjoys or makes use of, an enjoyer, possessor, ŚvetUp.; VarBṛS.
उपभोग: enjoying (a woman or a lover), VP.; Ragh. &c.
उपभोगक्षम: उप-भोग—क्षम mfn. suited to enjoyment, Śak.
उपभोगिन्: उपभोगिन् mfn. ifc. enjoying, making use of.
उपभोग्य: उप-भोग्य mfn. to be enjoyed or used
anything enjoyed or used, BhP.; Kum.; Pañcat. &c.
उप-भोग्य n. object of enjoyment, MBh.; Mṛcch.
उपभोग्यत्व: उप-भोग्य—त्व n. the state of being enjoyable, R.
उपभोज्य: उप-भोज्य mfn. ifc. serving for food, causing enjoyment, MBh.
उपभू: उप-√ भू P. (pf. Pot. 2 sg. -बभूयास्; aor. Subj. 2. sg. -भुवस्) to come near to, approach, RV. x, 183, 2; to help, assist, RV. i, 138, 4 : Intens. -बुभूषति, to wish to help, MBh. xii, 3514.
उपभूष्: उप-√ भूष् P. -भूषति, to approach (in order to revere), RV. x, 104, 7; to regard, be careful, pay attention to, observe, obey, RV.
उपभूषण: उप-भूषण n. secondary ornament or decoration
उपभृ: उप-√ भृ P. Ā. (p. -बि॑भ्रत्; Impv. 2. sg. -भरस्व) to bring or convey near, RV. i, 166, 2; AV. v, 20, 4; to bear, Kir. v, 12.
उपभृत्: उप-भृत् f. a sacrificial vessel or ladle made of wood, AV. xviii, 4, 5; 6; VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.
उपभृत: उप-भृत mfn. brought near, procured for (dat.)
उपभृतोपशम: उपभृतोपशम mfn. one to whom calmness of mind is brought, calm, quiet, BhP. v, 7, 10.
उपभैमी: उप-भैमी ind. besides Bhaimī (i.e. Damayantī), Naiṣ.
उपभ्रम्: उप-√ भ्रम् P. (pf. -बभ्राम) to saunter or move slowly towards, BhP.
उपम: most excellent, eminent, best, RV.; AV.
2. उपम mfn. ifc. for 3. उप-मा q.v.
उपमश्रवस्: उपम॑—श्रवस् mfn. of highest fame, highly renowned
उपम॑—श्रवस् m. N. of a son of Kuru-śravaṇa and grandson of Mitrātithi, RV. x, 33, 6; 7
उपमश्रवस्तम: उपम॑—श्रवस्—तम mfn. highly renowned, illustrious, RV. ii, 23, 1.
उपमा: 1. उपमा॑ (for 2. See below, and for 3. See col.3) ind. (Ved. instr. of the above) in the closest proximity or neighbourhood, RV. i, 31, 15; viii, 69, 13.

2. उप-√ मा P. Ā. (Impv. 2. sg. -मिमीहि, -माहि, and -मास्व; Subj. 2. sg. -मासि) to measure out to, apportion to, assign, allot, grant, give, RV. : Ā. -मिमीते, to measure one thing by another, compare, MBh.; Hariv.; Caurap. &c.
3. उप-मा॑ f. comparison, resemblance, equality, similarity
a resemblance (as a picture, portrait &c.), ŚBr.; MBh.; Kum. &c.
a particular figure in rhetoric, simile, comparison (a full simile must include four things; See पूर्णोपम, लुप्तोपमा, &c.), Sāh.; Kāvyâd.; Vām. &c.
उप-मा (mfn. ifc.) equal, similar, resembling, like (e.g. अमरोपम mfn. resembling an immortal), MBh.; Ragh.; Daś.; Hit. &c.
उपमाम्: उपमा॑म् ind. in the highest degree, RV. v, 34, 9; AV. viii, 3, 65; SV.
उपमज्ज्: उप-√ मज्ज् P. Ā. -मज्जति, -ते, to dive, sink, ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; ŚāṅkhŚr. Comm. on KātyŚr.
उपमज्जन: उप-मज्जन n. ablution, bathing, a bath, BhP.
उपमथ्: उप-√ मथ् P. -मन्थति, to whirl around, RV. x, 136, 7; to stir, churn, mix, TBr. i, 6, 8, 4; 5.
उपमथित: उप-मथित mfn. stirred, churned, mixed, ŚBr. ii, 6, 1, 6; Kauś.
उपमन्थनी: उप-मन्थनी॑ a f. a staff for stirring, ŚBr.
उपमन्थितृ: उप-मन्थितृ॑ mfn. one who stirs or churns (butter &c.), VS. xxx, 12.
उपमद्: उप-√ 1. मद् P. -मदति, to cheer up, encourage, ŚBr. i, 4, 2, 1.
उपमाद: उप-मा॑द a m. enjoyment, amusement, RV. iii, 5, 5.
उपमद्गु: उप-मद्गु m. N. of a younger brother of Madgu, Hariv.; VP.
उपमध्यमा: उप-मध्यमा f. (scil. अङ्गुलि) the finger next to the middle finger, the last finger but one, ĀpŚr. iii, 1, 2.
उपमन्त्र्: उप-√ मन्त्र् P. Ā. -मन्त्रयति, -ते to call near or towards one's self, call hither, induce to come near, TS.; ŚBr.; to summon, invite, persuade, MBh.; Kām.; BhP.; to address.
उपमन्त्रण: उप-मन्त्रण n. the art of persuading coaxing (= रहस्य् उप-च्छन्दनम्, Kāś.), Pāṇ. i, 3, 47.
उपमन्त्रित: उ॑प-मन्त्रित mfn. called near or hither, ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.
उपमन्त्रिन्: 1. उप-मन्त्रि॑न् mfn. persuading, inciting, impelling, RV. ix, 112, 4.
2. उप-मन्त्रिन् m. a subordinate counsellor, BhP.
उपमन्यु: उप-मन्यु॑ mfn. striving after, zealous ([BRD.]), RV. i, 102, 9
उप-मन्यु m. N. of a Ṛṣi (pupil of Āyoda-dhaumya, who aided Śiva in the propagation of his doctrine and received the ocean of milk from him), MBh.; LiṅgaP.; Kathās. &c.
उप-मन्यु॑ m. pl. (अवस्) the descendants of the above, ĀśvŚr. (cf. औपमन्यव.)
उपमर्द: उप-मर्द b m. friction, rubbing down
destruction, MBh. Comm. on BṛĀrUp. and, Nyāyad.
उपमाद्रव्य: उप-मा॑—द्रव्य n. any object used for comparison, Kum.
उपमारूपक: उप-मा॑—रूपक n. (in rhet.) a particular figure combining comparison and metaphor, Vām.
उपमाव्यतिरेक: उप-मा॑—व्यतिरेक m. (in rhet.) a particular figure combining comparison and contrast, Kāvyâd.
उपमेत: उपमेत m. the tree Vatica Robusta, L.
(वृक्षाणां मध्ये तस्य सर्वोच्चत्वाद् अन्यस्योपोमानतां प्राप्तत्वात् तथात्वम्, T.)
उपमाति: 1. उ॑प-माति f. (for 2. See s.v.), इस् comparison, similarity ([Sāy.]), RV.
उ॑प-माति m. (इस्) ‘assigning or granting’ (wealth), N. of Agni ([Sāy.]), RV. viii, 60, 11
(BRD. derives both 1. and 2. उप-माति fr. उप-√ मन्, ‘to address.’)
2. उप-माति f. (√ 1. मी, Sāy.), destroying, killing.
उपमातृ: 1. उप-मातृ mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) one who compares, Naiṣ.
2. उप-मातृ f. ‘second mother’, foster-mother, nurse, L.
उपमान: उप-मान n. comparison, resemblance, analogy, MBh.; Suśr.; Kathās. &c.
the object with which anything is compared, Pāṇ.; Sāh.; Kum. &c.
(in log.) recognition of likeness, comparison (the third of the four Pramāṇas or means of correct knowledge)
उपमानचिन्तामणि: उप-मान—चिन्ता-मणि m. N. of a philosophical work.
उपमानत्व: the state of being an object of comparison, Sāh.; Vām.
उपमानोपमेयभाव: उपमानोपमेय-भाव m. the connection between the thing to be compared and the object with which it is compared.
उपमित: 1. उप-मित mfn. (for 2. See उप-√ मि) compared, illustrated by comparison, Pāṇ.; Bhartṛ. &c.
2. उप-मित (for 1. See above) mfn. stuck or fastened on, put into, Vait.
उपमिति: knowledge of things derived from analogy or resemblance, Sarvad.
उपमेय: उप-मेय mfn. to be compared, comparable with (with instr. or ifc.), Megh.; Kum. &c.
उप-मेय n. that which is compared, the subject of comparison (opposed to उप-मान, the object with which anything is compared), Sāh. Comm. on Pāṇ.
उपमेयोपमा: उपमेयोपमा f. the resemblance of any object to that compared with it
reciprocal comparison (as of a moon to a beautiful face), Vām.; Kpr.
उपमात्: उप-मा॑त् f. a prop, support = उपमि॑त् below ([Sāy.]), RV. vi, 67, 6.
उपमातिवनि: उप-माति—व॑नि mfn. engaged in killing enemies, destroyer of enemies ([Sāy.]), RV. v, 41, 16
(fr. उप-√ मन्, one who receives addresses in a friendly way, BRD.)
उपमारण: उप-मारण b n. the act of throwing into water, submerging, KātyŚr. xx, 8, 22.
उपमालिनीतीरम्: उप-मालिनी-तीरम् ind. near the banks of the Mālinī, Śak. 16, 7.
उपमास्य: उ॑पमास्य mfn. (fr. उप-मासम्), occurring every month, monthly, AV. viii, 10, 19.
उपमि: उप-√ 1. मि P. -मिनोति, to stick or fasten on, put into, Kāṭh.
उपमित्: उप-मि॑त् f. a prop, stay, RV. i, 59, 1; iv, 5, 1; AV. ix, 3, 1.
उपमित्र: उप-मित्र n. a minor friend, not an intimate friend, Nīlak.
उपमिह्: उप-√ मिह् Caus. -मेहयति, to wet, BhP. vi, 16, 32.
उपमीमांसा: उप-मीमांसा (fr. Desid. of √ मन्), deliberation, investigation, consideration, ŚBr. xi, 4, 2, 12; 15.
उपमुखम्: उप-मुखम् ind. on the mouth, Lāṭy. iv, 2, 6.
उपमुच्: उप-√ मुच् Ā. -मुञ्चते, to put on (e.g. shoes), TS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.
उपमूलम्: उप-मूल॑म् ind. on or at the root, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.; Gobh.
उपमृ: उप-√ मृ Caus. -मारयति, to throw into water, plunge, immerse, ŚBr. Comm. on KātyŚr.;  (with अप्सु), ĀpŚr. viii, 8, 12.
उपमृत: उ॑प-मृत mfn. died, dead, TS. vi, 2, 8, 6.
उपमृज्: उप-√ मृज् P. -मार्ष्टि (3. pl. -मृजन्ति, RV. ix, 15, 7) to stroke; to touch, sweep, wipe, cleanse, TBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
उपमृद्: उप-√ मृद् P. -मृद्नाति, to graze in passing (said of a heavenly body in its transit), VarBṛS.; to crush, destroy, annul, Naiṣ. Comm. on BṛĀrUp. : Caus. -मर्दयति, to destroy, devastate, annul, annihilate, BhP. Comm. on ChUp. and, BṛĀrUp.
उपमर्दक: उप-मर्दक mfn. destroying, annulling, oppressing, Hariv.; Kathās.; Sarvad.
उपमर्दन: उप-मर्दन n. the act of injuring, violation
उपमर्दिन्: उप-मर्दिन् mfn. ifc. destroying, annulling, BhP.
उपमॄ: उप-√ मॄ Pass. (p. -मूर्य॑माण) to be worn away or destroyed, ŚBr. i, 7, 3, 21; 4, 12.
उपमेखलम्: उप-मेखलम् ind. about or on the slopes or sides (of a mountain), Kir. vii, 32.
उपम्लुच्: उप-√ म्लुच् P. (pf. -मुम्लोच) to hide one's self among (with gen.), ŚBr. i, 2, 5, 8.
उपम्लुप्त: उ॑प-म्लुप्त mfn. hidden, concealed, TBr. iii, 2, 9, 4.
उपयज्: 1. उप-√ यज् P. Ā. -यजति, -ते, to sacrifice in addition to, TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; PārGṛ. Comm. on VS. vi, 21.
2. उप-य॑ज् f. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 73) N. of eleven additional formulas at an animal sacrifice (enumerated in VS. vi, 21), TS.; MaitrS.; ŚBr.
उपयष्टृ: उप-यष्टृ m. the priest who utters the above formulas, ŚBr. iii, 8, 5, 5.
उपयाज: 1. उप-याज (for 2. See s.v.) m. = उपय॑ज्2 AitBr. ii, 18, 8; Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 3, 62.
2. उप-याज (for 1. See उप-√ यज्) m. N. of a younger brother of Yāja, MBh.
उपयत्: 1. उप-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to befall, ŚBr. viii, 5, 1, 7.
उप-यत् 2b mfn. (for 1. See s.v.) going near, approaching &c.
flowing into, attached, Kir. vi, 16 (said of rivers and female friends)
entering any state, serving for, Kir. vi, 26.
उपयन्त्रित: उप-यन्त्रित mfn. solicited or compelled to do anything, allured, Mn. xi, 177 (erroneous for उप-म°, BRD.)
उपयन्त्र: उप-यन्त्र n. a minor or secondary instrument or implement (esp. in surg.), Suśr.
a secondary application of any kind (as cautery, escharotics &c.), W.

उपस्पृश्: 1. उप-√ स्पृश् P. -स्पृशति, to touch above, reach up to, touch, RV.; AV.; to touch softly, caress, ŚBr.; AitBr.; ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.; MBh. &c. ;  (with or without अपः or जलम् &c.) to touch water (for ablution), wash, bathe (as a religious ceremony); to sip water (from the palm of the hand; it is not the custom to spit out the water after sipping it), ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr. & ĀśvGṛ.; MBh.; Yājñ.; Mn. &c.; to touch certain parts of one's body (acc.) with water (instr.), Mn. iv, 143;  (also without the instr.), Mn. v, 138;  (or without the acc.), MBh. : Caus. -स्पर्शयति, to cause to touch water or wash the hands, ŚBr. iii.

उपस्पर्श: washing, bathing, ablution (as a religious act), L.
sipping water (from the palm of the hand and swallowing it as a ceremonial), L.
उपस्पर्शन: उप-स्पर्शन n. the act of touching, KātyŚr. v, vi; SaṃhUp.
उपस्पृश्य: उप-स्पृश्य ind.p. having touched or sipping water &c.
उपस्पृष्ट: उप-स्पृष्ट mfn. touched (as water), sipped, Mn. iii, 208; MBh.; R.; BhP.
उपस्मि: उप-√ स्मि Ā. (pf. p. -सिष्मियाण॑) to smile upon, RV. x, 123, 5.
उपस्मृ: उप-√ स्मृ P. -स्मरति, to remember, ŚBr. ii; KātyŚr. Comm. on ChUp.
उपस्मारम्: उप-स्मारम् ind.p. having remembered, remembering. See यथोप°.
उपस्मृति: उप-स्मृति f. a minor law-book (the following authors of such books are named Jābāli, Nāciketa, Skanda, Laugākṣin, Kaśyapa, Vyāsa, Sanatkumāra, Śatarju, Janaka, Vyāghra, Kātyāyana, Jātūkarṇya, Kapiñjala, Baudhāyana, Kaṇāda, and Viśvāmitra), Hcat. i, 528, 21 ff.
उपस्रु: उप-√ स्रु P. (Impv. 3. pl. -स्रवन्तु) to stream or flow upon or towards, VS. xxxv, 20.
उपस्रवण: termination of the periodical flow of a woman, KātyŚr. xxv, 11, 13.
उपस्वत्व: उप-स्वत्व n. the produce or profit of property (as corn &c.), L.
उपस्वावत्: उप-स्वावत् m. N., of a son of Satrājit, Hariv.
उपस्विद्: उप-√ स्विद् Caus. -स्वेदयति, (in med.) to cause to sweat (by applying sudorifics), Suśr.
उपस्वेद: उप-स्वेद m. moisture, sweat, vapour, MBh.; Car.
उपस्वेदन: उप-स्वेदन n. the causing to sweat (by sudorifics), Car.
उपस्वृ: उप-√ स्वृ P. -स्वरति, to join in singing, Lāṭy. i, 8, 9.
उपहदन: उप-हदन n. the act of discharging excrement upon, VarBṛS.
उपहन्: उप-√ हन् P. -हन्ति Ā. -जिघ्नते, to beat, hit at, strike, touch, RV. vi, 75, 13; ŚBr. vi, xiv; Lāṭy.; ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. ii; to stick on, put on, force in, ram, TS. ii; TBr. i; ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; to take hold of, seize, take out; to hit, hurt, damage, visit, afflict, impede, spoil, TBr. iii; AitBr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.; to make a mistake in reciting, blunder, AitBr. iii, 35, 3; ŚāṅkhBr. : Pass. -हन्यते, ib.; TS. vii, 3, 1, 1; 2.
उपहत: उ॑प-हत mfn. hit, hurt, damaged, injured, visited, afflicted, pained, infected, ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Śak. &c.
distressed, weakened, discouraged, MBh.; R.; Hit.; Kathās.
scattered over, covered Comm. on Mn. iii, 208.
उपहतधी: उ॑प-हत—धी mfn. affected in mind, infatuated.
उपहतक: उपहतक mfn. ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky, L.
उपहति: उप-हति f. hurt, damage, injure, oppression, Kap.; Naiṣ.
(= अव-कर) a dust-heap, Sāy. on TāṇḍyaBr. i, 6, 5.
उपहत्नु: उप-हत्नु॑ mfn. hitting, hurting, destroying (enemies), RV. ii, 33, 11 = AV. xviii, 4, 40.
उपहत्या: उप-हत्या॑ f. hurt, damage, morbid affection (as of the eyes), AV. v, 4, 10.
उपहन्तव्य: उप-हन्तव्य mfn. to be killed, Kathās.
उपहन्तृ: उप-हन्तृ mfn. one who hurts or destroys, a destroyer, Sāy. on RV. ii, 33, 11
उपहव्य: उप-ह॑व्य b m. a secondary or supplementary libation or sacrifice, N. of a particular religious act, AV. xi, 7, 15; KātyŚr. xxii, 8; ĀśvŚr. &c.
उपहस्: उप-√ हस् P. -हसति, to laugh at, deride, ridicule, MBh.; L.; Mṛcch.; Pañcat. &c.; to smile: Caus. -हासयति, to deride, ridicule, BhP.; Kathās.
उपहसित: उप-हसित mfn. laughed at, derided, Kathās.
उप-हसित n. laughter accompanied by shaking the head (स-शिरः-कम्पम्), Daśar. iv, 70.
उपहस्वन्: उप-ह॑स्वन् mfn. laughing at, deriding, mocking, RV. viii, 45, 23.
उपहास: उप-हास॑ m. laughter, derision, mockery, jeer, Kathās.; Ragh.; Sāh.
fun, play, jest, sport, ŚBr.; PārGṛ.; MBh. &c.
उपहासगिर्: उप-हास॑—गिर् f. a joke, jest, L.
उपहासक: उप-हासक mfn. ridiculing others, jocose, L.
उप-हासक n. drollery, fun, BhP. x, 18, 15.
उपहासिन्: उप-हासिन् mfn. ifc. deriding, ridiculing, Sāh.; Veṇīs.
उपहास्य: उप-हास्य mfn. to be laughed at or derided, ridiculous, Mṛcch.; Kathās.
उपहास्यता: उप-हास्य—ता f. the state of being to be laughed at or derided, ridiculousness
(उपहास्यतां-√ गम्, to expose one's self to laughter, become ridiculous, Ragh. i, 3.)
उपहस्त: उप-हस्त m. the act of taking with the hand, receiving ([T.]) g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12, (not in Kāś.)
उपहस्तय: उपहस्तय Nom. P. उपहस्तयति, to take with the hand, receive, T.
उपहस्तिका: उपहस्तिका f. a box for betel or condiments, Daś.
उपहा: 1. उप-√ 2. हा Ā. (Pot. 2. sg. -जिहीथास्) to descend, come down upon, Śiś. i, 37.
2. उप-√ 3. हा Pass. -हीयते, to diminish, wane, MBh. xiii, 2028.
उपहालक: उप-हालक m. pl. N. of a people (= कुन्तल), L.
उपहिंस्: उप-√ हिंस् P. Ā. -हिंसति, -ते, to hurt, wound, injure, damage, MBh.; R.; Mn.
उपहु: उप-√ हु P. -जुहोति, to sacrifice or offer a libation in addition to, KātyŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Bhag.
उपहृ: उप-√ हृ P. -हरति, to bring near, reach forth, proffer, offer, place before, give to taste (esp. food), AV.; TBr.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr. and, ĀśvGṛ.; KātyŚr.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.; to put together, gather, collect, MBh.; BhP.; to apply (medicine), Suśr.; to take away; to destroy, MBh. ii : Ā. -हरते, to accept, receive, TS. v : Caus. -हारयति, to place before, proffer, offer, MBh.; R.; Suśr. : Desid. जिहीर्षति, to wish to offer, MBh. ii, 862.
उपहरण: उप-हरण n. the act of bringing near, proffering, offering, BhP.
उपहरणीय: उप-हरणीय mfn. to be offered or presented, Mālatīm.; Kathās.
उपहर्तृ: उप-हर्तृ mfn. one who offers or presents, one who serves out (food), a host, Mn. v, 51.
उपहार: उप-हार m. offering, oblation (to a deity)
complimentary gift, present (to a king or superior), MBh.; Megh.; Kathās. &c.
(उपहारं वि-√ धा, to offer an oblation to a god [acc.], sacrifice to any one, Kathās.)
a particular kind of alliance (purchased through a gift), Kām.; Hit. &c.
(with the Pāśupatas) a kind of religious service (consisting of laughter, song, dance, muttering हुडुक्, adoration and pious ejaculation), Sarvad. 77, 22.
उपहारत्व: उप-हार—त्व n. the state of being an oblation or offering, Kum.; Kathās.
उपहारवर्मन्: उप-हार—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Daś.
उपहारक: उपहारक mf(इका). an offering, oblation, gift, present, BhP.; Kathās.
उपहारीकृ: उप-हारी-√ कृ P. Ā. to offer (as an oblation or sacrifice), Kathās.; Hit.
उपहारीचिकीर्षु: उपहारी-चिकीर्षु mfn. intending to sacrifice any one, Kathās.
उपहार्य: उप-हार्य mfn. to be offered as an oblation
उप-हार्य n. an offering, oblation, MBh.; BhP.
उपहृत: उप-हृत mfn. brought near, offered, presented
उपहोम: उप-होम॑ m. an additional or supplementary sacrifice, ŚBr. xi.
उपह्वृ: उप-√ ह्वृ Ā. -ह्व॑रते, to approach by windings and turnings, reach an end after many deviations or errors, RV. i, 141, 1.
उपह्वर: उप-ह्वर॑ m. a winding or circuitous course full of turnings, uneven or rough ground, slope, declivity &c., RV. i, 62, 6; 87, 2; viii, 6, 28
उप-ह्वर॑ n. (generally ए loc.) proximity, nearness, RV. viii, 69, 6; MBh.
a solitary or private place, RV. viii, 96, 14; MBh.
उपह्वर्तव्य: उप-ह्वर्तव्य mfn. to be approached by windings and turnings, Sāy.
उपह्वे: उप-√ ह्वे only Ā. (Pāṇ. i, 3, 30) -ह्वयते (rarely P. Kathās.; BhP.) to call near to, invite, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr. &c.; to call up, invoke, AV. vi, 23, 1; VS. iii, 42; to call to, cheer, encourage, AitBr. iii, 20, 1; ĀśvŚr. ii, 16, 18 : Desid. -जुहूषति, to wish to call near, ŚāṅkhBr.
उपहव: उप-हव॑ m. calling to, inviting, invitation, (उप-हव॑म्-√ इष्, to desire an invitation to [loc.], wish to be invited to e.g. त॑स्मिन्न् इ॑न्द्र उपहव॑म् ऐच्छत, Indra wished to be invited to that [sacrifice] TS. ii, 4, 12, 1), TS.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.
उपहूत: उ॑प-हूत mfn. called near, invited, AV.; TBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh. &c.
that to which one invites, TS. i; ŚBr. i; KātyŚr. iii
summoned, invoked, AV. vii, 60, 4; 5; VS. xx, 35
उ॑प-हूत m. N. of Śākalya, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 2, 146
उ॑प-हूत m. pl. N. of particular manes, L.
उपहूति: उप-हूति f. calling (to fight), challenging, challenge, Śiś.
उपहूय: उप-हूय ind.p. having called near or invited &c.
उपह्वान: उप-ह्वान n. the act of inviting, invitation, KātyŚr.
उपा: उपा ind. a particular Nidhana or concluding chorus at the end of a Sāman, Lāṭy. vii, 10, 1 ff.; Sāy. on TāṇḍyaBr.
उपांशु: उपांशु ind. (fr. √ अंश्, ‘to divide’, with उप and affix उ, T. (?) g. स्वर्-आदि, Pāṇ. i, 1, 37), secretly, in secret, RV. x, 83, 7; MBh.; Ragh. &c.

a particular Soma oblation = उपांशु-ग्रह below, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.
उपांशुक्रीडित: उपांशु—क्रीडित m. a person jested with privately, the companion of (a king's) private amusements, Hit.
उपांशुग्रह: उपांशु—ग्रह m. the first Graha or ladle-full of Soma pressed out at a sacrifice, TS.; ŚBr. &c.
उपांशुता: उपांशु—ता, f. and उपांशु—त्व, n. the being uttered in a low voice or whisper, ŚāṅkhŚr. Comm. on Nyāyam.
उपांशुत्व: उपांशु—ता, f. and उपांशु—त्व, n. the being uttered in a low voice or whisper, ŚāṅkhŚr. Comm. on Nyāyam.
उपांशुदण्ड: उपांशु—दण्ड n. a punishment inflicted in private, R.
उपांशुपात्र: उपांशु—पात्र॑ n. the vessel or ladle for the Upāṉśu-graha q.v., ŚBr. iv; KātyŚr.
उपांशुयाज: उपांशु—याज॑ m. a sacrifice offered silently or with muttered prayers, ŚBr. i. &c.; TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr. &c.
उपांशुवध: उपांशु—वध m. a clandestine murder, Mudr.
उपांशुव्रत: उपांशु—व्रत n. a vow made secretly or privately, Hariv.
उपांशुसवन: उपांशु—स॑वन mfn. (used for) pressing out the Upāṉśugraha q.v. (said of stones so used), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Lāṭy. &c.
उपांशुहविस्: उपांशु—हविस् mfn. (a sacrifice) at which the offerings are made silently, ŚāṅkhŚr.
उपांश्वन्तर्याम: उपांश्व्-अन्तर्याम॑ m. du. N. of two particular ladles-full of Soma (offered with the breath held and inaudible), ŚBr. iv.
उपांश्वायतन: उपांश्व्-आ॑यतन mfn. having a silent abode, kept inaudible (as the breath), ŚBr. x.
उपाक: उ॑पाक b mf(आ)n. brought near to each other, joined, approximate, (only ए) f. du. (said of night and morning), RV. i, 142, 7; x, 110, 6 (उपा॑के), AV. v, 12, 6; 27, 8
उपाकृ: उपा-√ 1. कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, (Ved. impf. 1. sg. -अकरम्, 3. sg. -अकर्) to drive or bring near or towards, fetch, RV.; TS. vii; ŚBr.; ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. iii; to commit to, deliver, make over, give, bestow, grant (कामम्, a wish), MBh.; R.; to procure for one's self, obtain, MBh. iii, 10278; to bring or set about, make preparations (for a sacred ceremonial), undertake, begin, TS.; AitBr.; ŚBr. xiv; Lāṭy.; Mn. &c.; to consecrate, Mn. v, 7; Yājñ. i, 171.
उपाकरण: उपा-करण n. the act of bringing near, fetching, ŚBr.; PārGṛ. &c.
setting about, preparation, beginning, commencing, Āp.; ĀśvŚr. & ĀśvGṛ.; KātyŚr. &c.
commencement of reading the Veda (after the performance of preparatory rites, as initiation &c.), ŚāṅkhGṛ. iv, 5, 1
N. of a particular Stotra or prayer at sacrifices, KātyŚr. iii.
उपाकर्मन्: उपा-कर्मन् n. preparation, setting about, commencement (esp. of reading the Veda), PārGṛ. ii; Mn. iv, 119; Yājñ.
उपाकृत: उपा॑-कृत mfn. brought or driven near, fetched, AV. ii, 34, 2
attended with evil omens, disastrous, calamitous, L.
उपा॑-कृत m. a sacrificial animal (killed during the recitation of particular prayers), L.
उपाकृति: उपा-कृति f. setting about, beginning, L.
उपाकृतिन्: उपाकृतिन् mfn. one who prepares or begins g. इष्टादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 88.
उपाचिकीर्षु: उपा-चिकीर्षु mfn. (fr. Desid.), one who is about to undertake or commence Comm. on BṛĀrUp.
उपाक्रम्: उपा-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to fall upon, attack, MBh.
उपाक्ष: उपाक्ष m. (fr. 1. अक्ष), a particular part of a car (supporting the axletree) Comm. on Lāṭy. i, 9, 23.
उपाक्षम्: उपाक्षम् ind. (fr. अक्षि, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 121), on or near the eye.
उपाख्या: 1. उपा-√ ख्या Ā. (fut. 1. sg. -ख्यास्ये) to give an account about (anything), relate, BhP. ii, 9, 45.

उपाख्य: उपा-ख्य mfn. discernible, observable by the eye (cf. अन्-उपा° and निर्-उपा°.)
उपाख्यान: 1. उपा-ख्यान n. account, relation, repetition of an event, BhP.

उपागम्: उपा-√ गम् P. -गच्छति (Ved. उपागत: उपा-गत mfn. approached, arrived, come to (for protection)
entered into any state or condition, subject to, burdened with
occurred, happened, fallen to one's share
उपागा: उपा-√ गा P. -गाति, to come near, go towards, rush upon, RV. iii, 56, 2; x, 73, 5; ChUp.; Kathās.
उपाग्नि: उपाग्नि ind. on the fire, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 1, 41.
उपाग्निका: उपाग्निका f. (scil. भार्या) a wife given away in presence of the sacred fire or with due observance of the fire-ritual, a properly married wife, MBh. xiii, 2460.
उपाग्र: उपाग्र n. the part which is next to the end or top Comm. on Pāṇ.
उपाग्र्य: उपाग्र्य n. a secondary member, L.
उपागृह्य: उपा-गृह्य ind.p. having taken with, together with, BhP. x, 58, 55.
